title: Teach TOD to clear blocked objectives with evidence
goal: TOD learns to inspect, classify, group, repair, validate, and close blocked objectives without creating more stale paperwork.
current_problem: The system has many blocked objectives. TOD can report them, but needs a repeatable skill loop for clearing them safely with evidence.

training_loop.rule: Read the objective row, linked task row, evidence artifact, dispatcher status, and UI/operator status before deciding anything.
Assign exactly one primary blocker class: missing_executor, stale_heartbeat, linked_task_blocked, superseded, needs_human_decision, needs_codex_escalation, or already_resolved_stale_truth.
Group objectives by shared root cause so TOD fixes one cause once instead of making 28 separate repair objectives.
Choose from rebind_executor, inspect_task_evidence, reconcile_state, mark_superseded_with_evidence, create_narrow_task, request_human_input, or escalate_to_codex_with_reason.
Perform the smallest bounded action. Do not mark complete without fresh evidence.
Confirm objective row, task row, dispatcher status, artifact, and operator UI agree.
Record a prevention rule so the same blocker class is auto-handled next time.

blocker_class_rules.linked_task_blocked: If objective has a linked task already blocked_with_evidence, inspect that task evidence first. Do not create a replacement objective until the linked evidence is read.
blocker_class_rules.missing_executor: If no executor is bound, check whether an existing executor can handle the objective. If yes, bind/route. If no, create a narrow executor-binding task or escalate to Codex with exact target file/capability.
blocker_class_rules.stale_heartbeat: If objective is running but has no heartbeat, reconcile state to blocked_with_inspection unless a live child task exists.
blocker_class_rules.superseded: If a newer artifact or dashboard replaced the objective, mark superseded_with_evidence and link replacement.
blocker_class_rules.followup_not_currently_executing: Do not keep as active. Either materialize a specific task or mark parked_until_needed with evidence.
blocker_class_rules.artifact_missing: Recreate artifact only if still needed; otherwise mark superseded by current dashboard/evidence surface.

first_drill.goal: Classify all current blocked objectives into repair groups without mutating DB state.
success_criteria: all blocked objectives have one primary class
every class has a recommended repair action
no code or DB mutation performed
top 3 safest cleanup candidates are ranked

second_drill.goal: Clear one safe blocker group end-to-end with evidence.
success_criteria: state changed or narrower blocker published

hard_rules: No new objective when linked task evidence has not been inspected.
No executor-binding claim without registry/capability evidence.
No mass state mutation without dry-run reconciliation first.
If blocked remains blocked, publish a narrower blocked_with_inspection reason.
